I order you to surrender and stand by to be boarded, or we will be forced to destroy you !|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Vivant]]|<ref name="CE" />}}
The '''''Steadfast''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] in the service of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Afsheen Makati]] commanded the ''Steadfast'' at some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], and it was his personal destroyer for a while. The ship served during an investigation to a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base on [[Thila/Legends|Thila]]. Grand Admiral Makati was assisted by [[Supreme Prophet]] of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side]] [[Kadann]] during the investigation, and [[Vivant]] was its [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]]. Kadann overheard Vivant mocking his extravagant attire and admonished Makati with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] for his officer's insubordination.<ref name="who" />

[[File:Second_Battle_of_Phaeda.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Steadfast'' [[Battle of Phaeda|bombarding]] [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]].]]

Sometime between the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and the return of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] placed the ''Steadfast'' under [[Carnor Jax]]'s command. Vivant had became its [[Commander/Legends|commander]].<ref name="H2CE">[[Star Wars Handbook 2: Crimson Empire|''Star Wars Handbook'' 2: ''Crimson Empire'']]</ref>

The ''Steadfast'' was brought to [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]] to take over an orbital bombardment from the ''[[Emperor's Revenge]]'', allowing Jax to pursue [[Kir Kanos]] to [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]]. Vivant and the ''Steadfast'' were forced to surrender upon the [[Battle of Phaeda|arrival]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]''.<ref name="CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Daniel Wallace|Dan Wallace]] originally indicated in his article, ''[[Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals]]'', that [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Afsheen Makati]]'s personal ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer was named ''Steadfast''. However, the segment was cut. It was included in the ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', and is therefore canonized. When the article was originally due to appear in ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' in an article entitled ''[[Dirty Dozen: The Imperial Grand Admirals]]'', it was established that Makati's ''Steadfast'' was the same ship as the ''Steadfast'' appearing in ''Crimson Empire'', and the article also made reference to Vivant.
